words.title: Show or hide menus
words.device_note: This hides menus on this device only.
words.help: Hiding a menu only tidies it away. Nothing is turned off, and Jarvis can still do it when you ask. Asking Jarvis to hide or show a menu changes every device that hears it.
words.never_note: Some things always stay visible: approvals, security, What asks first, and the connection status.
words.tray_note: The system-tray menu is not affected.
words.hidden_speech_one: 1 menu hidden. Show or hide menus.
words.hidden_speech_many: {n} menus hidden. Show or hide menus.
words.folded_line: Folded. Tap Open to see it.

replies.hide: Done. On the devices that are open, the {title} menu is hidden. Nothing is turned off. Say "show the {title} menu" to bring it back.
replies.show: Done. On the devices that are open, the {title} menu is showing.
replies.collapse: Done. On the devices that are open, the {title} menu is folded to one line.
replies.expand: Done. On the devices that are open, the {title} menu is open.
replies.reset: Done. On the devices that are open, every menu is showing again.
replies.unknown: I don't know a menu called that.
replies.never: That one stays visible so you can always reach it.

defaults.note: Everything visible and unfolded. Advanced tabs on the desktop keep their own switch (a tab is shown only when BOTH allow it).

desktop.format: JSON array of strings, in localStorage, in try/catch

migration.text: Nothing to migrate: no earlier choice exists. Start with everything visible.
A stored id that no longer exists, or belongs to the other app, is ignored silently and dropped the next time the list is saved.
A never-hideable id found in the hidden set is ignored and dropped.
A stored version other than 1 is read as empty (everything visible) and is not overwritten until the owner changes something.
If storage cannot be read or written, everything shows and nothing crashes.
The Advanced switch, #more-options and 'Hide memory lists and chat history' keep their own storage; this store neither reads nor replaces them.

state_cases.name: hide one menu
hiding a group stores the group id only
a member hidden first is folded into the group
showing a group clears its members too
showing one member of a hidden group keeps the others hidden
showing a card of a hidden tab shows only that card
a card under a hidden tab is hidden and is not counted twice
a never-hideable menu is refused
an unknown id, and an id the other app has, are refused
a group with no member here is refused
folding and opening
a menu that cannot be folded is refused
folding a group folds its foldable members
showing does not touch the folded set
reset clears both sets
a link opens a hidden menu for the visit only
a link to a card opens its hidden tab for the visit
hiding a parent hides its rows
a row can be hidden alone
a group counts once
